fn royalTheme() {
  ret @4 C==== `B C D Eb===== F=
    G==== Eb F G Ab===== . C
    `B==== `G `B D G===== . A
    F#===== . E_ F===== . G
    E_===== . D Eb=========
    D= D== C#=== C=== `B====== `A `G
    C===== . F Eb==== D C D
    D===== C=
}

|: royalTheme() :|
fit(Eb, 3beat)

# Invert and double the 32-beat subject after a one-beat delay.
fit(., 1beat)
fit(mapPitches(subject(), (tone) => contrary(tone)), 2 * 32beat)
fit(c, 2beat)
